annotations.title: AI-written company report and bull and bear cases

description: Return the AI-written report on a company (business, segments, financial trajectory, capital allocation, and risks taken from the filing's own risk factors) or, with artefact "bull_bear", its bull and bear cases. The text is written by a model from FinancialMD's standardized facts and the company's own SEC filings only: no outside research, no news, no price targets, no buy, sell or hold view, no advice. Every claim lists the fact proof ids behind its numbers and the filing passage it rests on (accession, section, character span, quotation); data.grounding counts claims, cited and verified. When you repeat any of it, say it is AI-written, keep the citations, and never present it as reported fact, as an analyst's estimate or rating, or as investment advice. data.quality_scores are descriptive bands computed by published formulas from our own ratios, not ratings. Reports are versioned and point-in-time (as_of); a company without a published report answers not_found with details.status. Use it for a cited plain-language overview of a company; for the numbers themselves call financials_standardized or ratios.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

name: company_research

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { artefact, version, generated_by: "model", model, method_version, generated_at, source_filings, disclaimer, sections: [{ key, claims: [{ text, facts, derived, passages, numbers }] }], grounding: { claims, cited, verified }, quality_scores, versions, filing_summaries } from GET /v1/company/research (company_report) or GET /v1/company/bull_bear (bull_bear).

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: AI-written company report and bull and bear cases
